gates.detail: explain: 74/74 clean terminal states (74 not applicable, 0 unexpected); extract: 106/106 clean terminal states (0 unexpected) — mode echo, provider baseline

gates.name: extract-negative-mislabel
gates.detail: negativeTerms mislabel (term level) = 44/318 = 13.8% (gate ≤10%); separately: full-negative item level 51/51 = 100.0%, unlisted extra marks 761

gates.name: usefulness
gates.detail: 有用率 (≥90%) needs two-person annotation of annotation-sheet.csv (rater1/rater2 + arbitration); never asserted mechanically

gates.name: key-obstacle-coverage
gates.detail: 关键理解障碍覆盖率 (≥80%) needs two-person annotation (key_obstacle columns + arbitrated useful explanations); never asserted mechanically

checks.name: set-integrity
checks.detail: dev 180 + frozen 180; group ids and source texts never straddle; zh 259/360; negatives 103/360 = 28.6%; six categories in both; every explain term resolves by occurrence with slice equality; extract term lists verified against sources

checks.name: echo-selftest
checks.detail: 17/17 synthetic checks pass (metric math, gate flip, frozen lock, secret scan, baseline determinism)

selftest.name: selftest:nth-occurrence

selftest.name: selftest:frozen-lock

selftest.name: selftest:frozen-lock-2
